description.zh: 以客观网格与排版传达信息的视觉语言：严密的数学网格、无衬线字体、左对齐、 黑白加一个强调色（经典为红），用留白与字号对比建立秩序。装饰被视为噪音， 设计的目标是让信息以最短的路径被读懂。
description.en: A visual language of objective grids and typography: strict mathematical grids, sans-serif faces, flush-left setting, black and white plus one accent (classically red). Order comes from whitespace and type scale. Decoration is noise; the goal is information read along the shortest path.

use_when.zh: 设计系统 博物馆 文化机构，需要客观严谨的秩序感
use_when.en: Design systems, museums and institutions that need objective rigor

use_when.zh: 数据 技术文档 目录类内容，结构化信息为主
use_when.en: Data, documentation and catalog content that is inherently structured

use_when.zh: 海报 期刊封面等需要强烈排版张力的场景
use_when.en: Posters and covers that thrive on typographic tension

avoid_when.zh: 品牌需要亲和 温暖或娱乐化的情绪
avoid_when.en: Brands needing warmth, approachability or playfulness

avoid_when.zh: 内容零散无结构，网格反而放大凌乱感
avoid_when.en: Unstructured content — a strict grid only amplifies the mess

avoid_when.zh: 中文与衬线混排为主的阅读场景，风格语言不匹配
avoid_when.en: Reading contexts dominated by CJK and serif mixes — the idiom misfits

note.zh: Josef Müller-Brockmann 的严格模数网格
Emil Ruder 与 Armin Hofmann，更重字体排印节奏
note.en: Emil Ruder and Armin Hofmann — typographic rhythm first

note.zh: 当代网页化的瑞士风，等宽字与细线引入
note.en: Contemporary web-flavored Swiss with mono type and hairlines

notes.zh: 先立网格：12 列或简单 3×3，所有元素吸附网格线，禁止任意间距。字体只用 一套无衬线（Helvetica/Inter/Neue Haas），层级靠字号跳跃（如 12/48px） 而非加粗渐变；正文左对齐，禁用居中排版。色彩为黑 白 灰 + 单一强调红， 红只出现在标题标号与关键线上。分隔用粗细两种横线（2px/1px）。
notes.en: Grid first: a 12-column or simple 3×3 grid that every element snaps to — no arbitrary spacing. One sans family (Helvetica/Inter/Neue Haas); hierarchy from size jumps (e.g. 12/48px), not weight ramps; flush-left text, centered setting banned. Black, white, grey plus a single red that only marks indices and key rules. Separate with two rule weights (2px/1px).

basic.zh: 用瑞士风格（Swiss Style）设计界面：严格网格排版、无衬线字体、左对齐、 黑白加单色强调红，层级靠字号对比与留白建立。
basic.en: "Design an interface in Swiss Style: strict grid typography, sans-serif, flush-left, black-and-white with a single red accent, hierarchy from scale contrast and whitespace."

design.zh: 瑞士风格设计规范：白色底 黑色 Helvetica（或 Inter）；建立 12 列网格并 让所有元素对齐；标题字号与正文形成 4 倍以上跳跃；强调色仅用一个红色 #E30613，用于标号与粗横线；留白宽松且成模数（8 的倍数）；无阴影 无 渐变 无圆角（或极小圆角）；深色模式为近黑底 反白字 红色保留。
design.en: "Swiss style spec: white ground, black Helvetica (or Inter); a 12-column grid everything aligns to; headings at 4x+ body size; one red #E30613 for indices and heavy rules only; generous modular whitespace (multiples of 8); no shadows, gradients or big radii. Dark mode: near-black ground, inverted text, red retained."

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 实现瑞士风格：外层 .swiss-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 16px; }；标题 font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em；分隔线 .rule { border-top: 2px solid #000 } 与 .rule-thin { border-top: 1px solid #ccc }；编号用红色等宽小字。
implementation.en: "Implement Swiss style in CSS: .swiss-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 16px; }; headings in 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 44px/1.05, letter-spacing -0.02em; .rule { border-top: 2px solid #000 } and .rule-thin { border-top: 1px solid #ccc }; indices in small red mono type."

agent.zh:
在当前项目中用瑞士风格（Swiss Style）实现一个排版主导的信息区块。

先检查现有 Design Token 与字体栈，网格间距映射到现有间距变量。
要求：
- 建立 12 列网格，所有元素吸附网格线，间距成模数
- 单一无衬线字体，层级靠字号跳跃不靠加粗渐变
- 黑白灰 + 单一强调红，红只用于标号与关键线
- 正文左对齐，分隔用 2px/1px 两种横线
- 支持深色模式
- 不新增任何依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a typography-led Swiss Style section in the current project.

Inspect the existing design tokens and font stacks first; map grid spacing onto the current spacing variables.
Requirements:
- A 12-column grid every element snaps to; modular spacing
- One sans-serif family; hierarchy from size jumps, not weight ramps
- Black, white, grey plus a single red reserved for indices and key rules
- Flush-left text; 2px/1px rule hierarchy
- Dark mode support
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
